caption: A candle tips and a drop of liquid wax falls onto a wooden table, where it hardens into a small white disc.

sa.check: A candle is tipped to one side.
A drop of liquid wax falls from it onto a wooden table.
The wax hardens into a small disc.
The set wax is white and dull.
The order is fall, spread, set.

pc.expect: The drop spreads once as it lands, then stops moving and stays where it set for the rest of the clip.
pc.fail: The set disc turns liquid again and flows on with nothing heating it; or the disc draws back into a bead and lifts off the table; or the wax spreads, stops and spreads again with none added.

pc.expect: The wax lands as a thin liquid that flows briefly, then sets as a rigid solid: it goes from glossy and see-through to dull and opaque and sits on the wood as one piece.
pc.fail: The wax stays a glossy liquid bead for the rest of the clip; or it soaks into the wood and disappears; or the set disc bends or flows when the table is knocked.

pc.expect: The drop falls downward from the candle's rim to the table.
pc.fail: The drop travels upward from the candle; or hangs in the air part-way down; or moves sideways across the room with nothing blowing it.

pc.expect: The candle moves only as it is tipped, and the table and the set disc stay put.
pc.fail: The candle rights itself with nothing touching it; or the disc slides across the table; or the table shifts as the drop lands.

pc.expect: One drop leaves the candle and one disc lies on the table; wax neither appears nor vanishes.
pc.fail: A second disc appears where no drop landed; or the disc vanishes; or the drop passes through the table; or the candle's wax grows back as the drop leaves.

pc.expect: The candle's colour, the table's grain away from the disc and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The candle changes colour; or the table's grain changes pattern; or objects on the table rearrange.
